note: UNSIGNED. Nothing broadcast. Each tx: baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <treasury> --to <to> --value 0 --inputData <data>, then execute only after explicit user approval.

txs.description: Deploy BnagentMint via the CREATE2 deployer proxy (also deploys BnagentToken and creates the official, empty PancakeSwap BNAGENT/USDT pair). Mint starts PAUSED. No liquidity is added by contracts: 100% of mint payments go to the treasury; at share 10,000 the treasury receives 400B BNAGENT, adds LP itself, then calls openTrading().
Open minting: treasury calls setPaused(false) on the mint contract (only after the website shows the deployed addresses).
